# Throughput (generated by scripts/throughput.py)

in_valid always 1; out_ready random with prob ready_p; 50 warm-up cycles then a 4000-cycle window; ops_per_cycle = outputs accepted in window / 4000; latency = cycle accepted at input -> cycle accepted at output
